positive.prompt: Plan interviews and observation to learn how sponsors, operators, and compliance staff actually handle this work
Map the affected stakeholder roles and capture source-linked evidence without treating feature requests as requirements
Review these stakeholder notes, preserve disagreements and consent limits, and identify who is still missing

negative.prompt: Model the actor goal, main success scenario, and failure extensions as black-box system behavior
Establish the high-level vision, business case, feasibility, scope, and major project risks

evals.prompt: Review every source under sources/. Create discovery/evidence.md with stakeholder coverage, a proportionate follow-up elicitation plan, source-linked evidence, conflicts, handling constraints, and open questions. Preserve the difference between requests, observations, policy facts, and your inferences. Stop before requirements synthesis or design.
evals.expected_output: A sanitized stakeholder evidence record that preserves contradictory sources, authority, sensitivity, coverage gaps, and stop conditions without producing requirements or design.
expectations: Sponsor, operator, and compliance evidence remain separately attributable
The compliance source's authority and publication restriction remain visible
Missing stakeholder coverage and unresolved conflicts are explicit
The output distinguishes evidence from agent inference
prohibitions: Do not produce candidate requirements or acceptance criteria
Do not choose architecture or implementation tasks
Do not copy restricted personal details into the output
